fair_value_reason: 2028E total EPS of about $14.3 (base ~$9.45 plus enhanced ~$4.85, interpolated from the guided 2027 and 2029 tools, with ~1% buyback accretion) x 19x = $272, blended 50/50 with 2028 FCFbG of about $5.9B / ~350M shares = $16.9 at a 6.6% yield = $256. That gives about $264, rounded to $265, ex-dividend. It is down from my round-1 $272 because every agent now uses a higher FCF yield, and against a round-2 agent mean of $266 it removes the ~$0.3 of 2028E EPS that agents 4 and 5 carried above the framework.
supervisor_summary: In round 2 all five forecasters took up the round-1 fact-checks (the base-EPS framework, the 5.24% 10y, the 25M-share unlock in June 2027). Their fair values fell from a mean of $279 to $266 (range $255-275), and P(>=spot) from 0.536 to 0.508. The one new factual dispute goes against the bulls. agent_5's claim that the Q2 deck raised 2027 enhanced margin misreads the 2026 column, so 2027 EPS stays about $12.0-12.4, roughly 8-10% below the $13.34 consensus, and 2028E is about $14.3. I set fair value at $265, about spot, and the thesis break at $195, shading the ladder 0.3-0.5 points around spot. Confidence is low: this is essentially the forecasters' mean.
key_drivers: The earnings path is the management framework, not consensus. Base EPS is guided at 20%+ CAGR 2026-29 and the 2027 enhanced margin is unchanged at $2.15-2.55B, so 2027 total is about $12.0-12.4 against $13.34 consensus and 2028 is about $14.2-14.4.
Rates: the 10y is at 5.24% (4.94% on 9/17) after the Sep 17 hike, which caps the multiple at about 19x forward and the FCF yield at 6.5-6.75%.

Supply: about 38M Calpine-consideration shares remain with former holders, about 11-13M of them free now and about 25M unlocking on 2027-06-30, against ~$2.8B of remaining buyback authority that is still intact after RISEC.
PJM: capacity is locked at the ~$325/MW-day cap through May 2029. RBP results come Dec 2 and the 2029/30 BRA in December 2026, both under the collar.
Upside optionality: 147M MWh of open nuclear output available for premium PPAs, plus the Crane restart in 2027.
